text:
june: Heads up 6060 opened a small docs PR to fix the Models Settings endpoint. The API ref currently documents `temperature` and `top_k` as integers but the runtime accepts floats for temperature and nullable ints for top_k. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4920

nora: can you paste the wrong snippet?

june: sure. Current example in the page is:
```json
PATCH /v1/models/{model_id}/settings
{
  "temperature": 1,
  "top_k": 50,
  "max_tokens": 1024
}
```
That makes it look like temperature is strictly an integer 0/1 and top_k is required. The runtime tolerates floats (e.g., 0.7) and top_k is optional (nullable). Also the OpenAPI schema lists temperature as `integer` which caused the docs linter to fail when I tried to include a realistic float example.

kevin: good catch. we standardized on temperature: number (0.0 to 1.0), top_k: integer|null, and max_tokens: integer. docs should reflect that and examples should show a 0-1 float for temperature.

june: proposed replacement snippet:
```json
PATCH /v1/models/{model_id}/settings
{
  "temperature": 0.75,
  "top_k": null,
  "max_tokens": 1024
}
```
I added a note: "temperature accepts decimal values between 0 and 1; use null for top_k to disable k-filtering."

docs-bot: lint failed on PR earlier: components.schemas.ModelSettings.properties.temperature type mismatch (expected number, found integer). See CI: https://ci.redwood-inference/1600/logs/210 :warning:

nora: ok update needed in two places: 1) OpenAPI components.schemas.ModelSettings -> temperature: number; 2) examples generator template for PATCH snippets was using integer defaults. also update the SDK snippets (py/go) to show float.

kevin: i'll update the OpenAPI YAML and the snippet template. watch out for the schema validators downstream; we need to bump the example tests so they accept decimal temperature values. add a small unit test that renders the HTML and asserts the snippet contains '"temperature": 0.75'.

june: added the YAML patch and updated the examples in the PR. also included a short paragraph in the docs explaining rounding behavior clients might see when using certain integer-only SDKs.

docs-bot: re-run results: linter passes after schema change, but docs build failed due to a stale cached example fixture. Error: example-fixtures/models-settings.json mismatch. See build 215: https://ci.redwood-inference/1600/builds/215 :x:

kevin: i'll update the fixture and the docs-test to regenerate fixtures when schema changes. pushing fix now.

kevin: pushed fixture regen and added the assertion in docs-tests. re-running CI.

docs-bot: CI passed on branch fix/models-settings-types (build 217) :white_check_mark: https://ci.redwood-inference/1600/builds/217

tara: quick follow-up request from SDK team: can you add a short migration note in the API ref that older clients may send `1` for temperature and that SDKs will coerce ints to floats when constructing the HTTP payload? helps reduce support noise.

june: added a one-line migration note and a Python example showing coercion: `payload['temperature'] = float(payload.get('temperature', 1.0))`. pushed to the PR.

nora: looks good. i'll merge after CI green. thanks for the fast fix everyone.

docs-bot: merged fix/models-settings-types into main (build 218) :white_check_mark: https://ci.redwood-inference/1600/builds/218

june: closing thread. thanks! :tada:
